name: search
description: Find files by name or content, newest first unless text is given. With no filters, lists recently modified files. Skips the trash.

text.description: Words to find in the file name or content.

type.description: Only this kind: folder, document, spreadsheet, presentation, pdf, image, video or audio.

folder_id.description: Only direct children of this folder.

shared_with_me.description: Only files others shared with the user. Default false.

query.description: Raw Drive query, combined with the other filters, e.g. modifiedTime > '2026-01-01' or 'anna@example.com' in owners.

page_token.description: next_page_token from the previous call, to get the next page.
